name: review-pr
description: Collects a PR diff, runs parallel security/style/logic analysis, then summarizes findings into an actionable review

agents.name: diff-collector
agents.prompt: Collect the git diff for the current branch against main

agents.name: security-scanner
agents.prompt: Scan the diff for security vulnerabilities

agents.name: style-checker
agents.prompt: Check the diff for style and convention issues

agents.name: logic-reviewer
agents.prompt: Review the diff for logic errors and edge cases

agents.name: review-summarizer
agents.prompt: Compile all findings into a final code review with verdict
